column1: # China's published lists of goods whose import needs a licence or is banned, searched whole for computers, computer parts and chips: one row per list or section of a list, 22 rows, made on Nov 25, 2026. For each: the list; its year; the announcement that issued it; the saved copy, with the type, size and the first sixteen digits of the sha256 of its file; whether the copy has a text layer and how long it is; a control (a customs number or a word the list is known to hold) and whether the search found it; the customs numbers under headings 8471, 8473 and 8542 found where a number begins; the raw counts of those four digits with spaces removed; and counts of ten words (集成电路, 处理器, 图形处理器, 服务器, 自动数据处理设备 and others). What the rows show: the nine licence lists of 2024 to 2026 (goods under import licence, goods under automatic import licence, and the import section of the dual-use list, three years each; one of them saved in two layouts, so ten rows) hold none of those numbers and none of those words, while the export section of the same dual-use lists holds five such numbers, which shows the search can find them. In the list of banned USED electromechanical goods the heading 84.71 stands only inside the names of used monitors made to connect to data-processing machines (customs numbers under 8528): no computer, computer part or chip is on that list. One list of banned imports still in force (batch 6, issued in 2005) is on the ministry's page as its notice only; its annex was read in the Beijing Commerce Bureau's copy, a Word file (row ban-6: 17 lines, none of those numbers or words; a compliance site's copy of the notice with both annexes has the same 17 lines); batches 4 and 5 of 2002, on waste, are superseded and shown for the record. What the table cannot show: a restriction made outside the lists. The Foreign Trade Law allows goods outside the catalogues to be restricted for a time, measures taken on national-security grounds may stand outside the lists, and approvals by other bodies and unpublished measures are in no list.
